title: CABAC Dual Switching Dimmer Kit
descriptionHtml:
The CABAC Dual Switching Dimmer Kit is a push-button digital dimmer and remote switch bundle. Rated 230-240V AC 50Hz, it allows multi-way dimming and ON/OFF control over standard 2-wire wiring. The kit contains one HNS610DT dimmer and one HNS020RB remote button. It is certified to AS/NZS 60669.2.1 and CISPR15, with a maximum load rating of 350W and 1.5A current capacity. The HNS610DSDK suits dimmable LED and incandescent lighting but is not rated for fans or motors.

Retrofit dimmer projects often have only 2-wire circuits. Standard dimmers need 3-wire interconnection between switches, which is impractical in retrofits. The CABAC S-Click system uses a 2-wire link instead, removing the need for 3-wire runs. This allows faster, less disruptive installation in rentals, renos, and multi-room lighting.

Electricians and renovators value the CABAC HNS610DSDK for its quick install on existing 2-wire runs, the ability to add remote dimming without rewiring the walls, and the dual functionality that combines dimming and ON/OFF in a single kit. The push-button interface is intuitive: a quick tap powers the lights on at the last set brightness, holding the button dims up or down, and a double tap activates timed dimming that gradually lowers lights over 30 minutes — a feature trades appreciate for client-friendly end-of-day control. The certification to Australian standards and engineered protection against over-current, over-voltage, and over-temperature failures mean sparkies can confident specify the HNS610DSDK across renovation fleets without compatibility surprises.

Features

  • 2-wire multi-way dimming — allows remote dimming from multiple button locations using only a 2-wire connection, avoiding the need for 3-wire cabling in retrofit scenarios.
  • S-Click push-button interface — tap to toggle on at the last set brightness, hold to dim up or down, and double-tap to activate timed dimming that gradually reduces lighting over 30 minutes.
  • Maximum 350W load rating — supports up to 350W of dimmable LED, halogen, or incandescent load per the HNS610DSDK specifications and certification.
  • Certified to AS/NZS 60669.2.1 and CISPR15 — complies with Australian electrical standards for dimming switches and limits electromagnetic interference on radio frequency communications.
  • Ripple tone rejection and protection systems — rugged design with improved over-current, over-voltage, and over-temperature protection to safeguard against power supply fluctuations and thermal stress.
  • 1.5A maximum current capacity — rated for a maximum instantaneous current of 1.5A on the 230-240V circuit, typical for residential and light commercial retrofit dimming.
  • Not suitable for fans or motors — the HNS610DSDK is for resistive and dimmable loads only; it must not be used with ceiling fans, extractor fans, or 3-phase equipment.
  • Compatible with HPM and Clipsal wall plates — the push-button mechanism fits standard Australian wall plate styles, allowing integration into existing switchboard layouts without plate replacement.
  • Bundle includes dimmer and remote button — the HNS610DSDK ships with one HNS610DT dimmer module and one HNS020RB remote button, ready to wire and install.
  • 1-year domestic and commercial warranty — CABAC offers a 1-year warranty covering manufacturing defects, with coverage available for both residential and commercial installations.
  • Engineered and certified in Australia — the HNS610DSDK is an Australian-designed and certified product, manufactured to local electrical standards and available from Sparky Direct without import delays.
  • Smooth dimming with no flicker — users report smooth transitions at all brightness levels and consistent low-end dimming with no flickering or dead spots.

Where to use

  • Renovation and retrofit dimming — the HNS610DSDK is ideal for adding dimmer control to existing 2-wire circuits in renovation projects, rental property upgrades, and multi-room retrofits without rewiring the walls.
  • Multi-way lighting control — install the main dimmer in one location and place remote buttons in secondary positions to control the same lights from multiple entry points.
  • Dimmable LED downlight installations — the HNS610DSDK is proven to work with dimmable LED downlights, delivering smooth low-end dimming and flicker-free operation across the full brightness range.
  • Living areas and accent lighting — use the timed dimming feature (double-tap to reduce brightness over 30 minutes) in living rooms, bedrooms, and entertainment zones for gradual evening lighting transitions.
  • Residential and light commercial projects — the 350W maximum load and 1.5A rating suit residential homes, rental properties, hotel room lighting, and small commercial tenant spaces.
  • Existing 2-wire installations — where only 2-wire runs exist between switch locations, the CABAC system eliminates the need to install 3-wire interconnects and allows faster, less intrusive installation than traditional dimmers.

The CABAC HNS610DSDK is not suitable for controlling ceiling fans, exhaust fans, or any motor-driven equipment, regardless of wattage. Do not install in a circuit intended for fan speed control. This product is designed for stationary dimmable lighting loads only.

faq.q: Is the CABAC HNS610DSDK suitable for controlling ceiling fans or motor loads?
faq.a: No. The HNS610DSDK is for resistive and dimmable loads only (dimmable LEDs, halogen, incandescent). It must not be used on circuits controlling ceiling fans, exhaust fans, or any motor-driven equipment. Using the HNS610DSDK on a motor load may cause equipment damage or create a safety hazard.

faq.q: Can I use the HNS610DSDK to dim my LED downlights, and will there be flicker?
faq.a: Yes, the HNS610DSDK is compatible with dimmable LED downlights. The dimmer features ripple tone rejection and patented protection circuits to minimise flicker and deliver smooth transitions across the full brightness range. If your downlights flicker, confirm they are certified as dimmable before use.

faq.q: How does the 2-wire remote button work?
faq.a: The dimmer uses a 2-wire interconnection between the main unit and the remote button, allowing multi-way control without rewiring. Simply wire the remote button to the same circuit and the dimmer will recognise the control input. This avoids the need for a dedicated 3-wire run between switch locations.

faq.q: What is the timed dimming feature?
faq.a: Timed dimming activates when you double-tap the button while lights are on. The dimmer lowers brightness over 30 minutes and then turns off. If you double-tap when lights are off, brightness increases gradually to full over 30 minutes. This is useful for evening lighting transitions.

faq.q: What is the 350W maximum load on the HNS610DSDK, and why should I not exceed it?
faq.a: The HNS610DSDK is rated to switch and dim a maximum load of 350W. Exceeding this load may cause the dimmer to overheat, trigger the internal protection circuit, or cause permanent damage to the unit. Always confirm the total wattage of the connected lights before installation.

title: Cookson Controls 20433-3-1
subtitle: Hotwater Thermostat Adjustable Universal 50-70 Deg
descriptionHtml:
The Cookson Controls 20433-3-1 is a universal surface-mount hot water thermostat for single element electric storage systems, adjustable from 60 to 82 degrees Celsius. The 20433-3-1 carries a manual reset over-temperature safety cut-out, with screw terminals and contacts rated 240V 30A. It replaces Robertshaw and Klixon pattern thermostats fitted to a wide range of Australian storage hot water units.

When an electric storage unit stops making hot water, the thermostat is usually the part that has failed. On solar boosted systems it does the hardest work of any component in the tank, switching the booster element every time stored water drops below the set point. The 20433-3-1 covers that repair with a universal surface-mount pattern that suits single element systems from most Australian manufacturers. Carrying one on the truck saves a second trip when the badge on the tank turns out to be an odd one.

One part number covering most single element storage units keeps van stock simple, which is why the 20433-3-1 is often bought ten or twenty at a time. It lands as a cheaper option than a brand-matched spare and still carries the safety cut-out, so a call-out repair holds its margin. Screw terminals and a surface-mount fixing keep the changeover short: pull the access panel, transfer the wiring, set the dial. That turns an unknown tank brand into a same-visit repair rather than a return journey.

Features

  • 60 to 82 degree adjustment — the dial sets stored water temperature anywhere across the range, covering the 60 degree mark commonly specified for electric storage systems.
  • Manual reset over-temperature cut-out — trips on excess tank temperature and must be reset by hand, so a fault cannot quietly clear itself and repeat.
  • Universal single element fit — the 20433-3-1 suits single element electric storage hot water systems from a wide range of Australian manufacturers.
  • Surface-mount body — sits against the tank surface behind the access panel rather than inserting into a pocket or immersion sleeve.
  • 240V 30A screw terminals — contacts and terminals are rated for direct connection to standard domestic element circuits.
  • Robertshaw pattern replacement — replaces Robertshaw and Klixon equivalent thermostats across the storage hot water range.
  • Copper Klixon construction — the copper body carries tank temperature through to the switching mechanism without a capillary or probe.
  • Single element only — the 20433-3-1 controls one element and is not intended for twin element tanks running two thermostats.
  • Long list of superseded numbers — supersedes part numbers including 20433-3S, 6060607, W1M280 and DY399-33, which helps match older tanks.
  • Licensed installation — connection to the element circuit is electrical work and must be carried out by a licensed electrician.
  • One year warranty — covered for one year domestic and one year commercial from the invoice date, returned to Sparky Direct for assessment.

Where to use

  • Domestic electric storage tanks — the standard replacement thermostat for single element units under a residential access panel.
  • Solar boosted hot water systems — controls the electric booster element on solar storage tanks, where cycling duty is heaviest.
  • Rental and property maintenance — a fast no-hot-water fix on tenanted properties where the tank brand is not known before the visit.
  • Service van and truck stock — one universal part number covers most call-outs, so the 20433-3-1 travels well as bulk van stock.
  • Rural and remote properties — worth holding as an on-hand spare where a replacement part is days away by freight.
  • Older tanks with obsolete part numbers — the superseded number list lets the 20433-3-1 cover units whose original thermostat is no longer made.
  • Light commercial single element units — suits small storage tanks in shops, sheds and site amenities running one element.

The 20433-3-1 is not suitable for twin element tanks that run a separate thermostat on each element, and it is not a gas or heat pump control. It is a surface-mount thermostat, so it does not fit tanks that require a probe or capillary thermostat in an immersion pocket. Setting storage temperature at the thermostat does not replace outlet temperature control at the fixtures.

"Been using these for 40 years or more. Kills the modern stuff" — Gary

"A good cheaper option" — Jason

"All good" — Lyndsay

faq.q: What temperature range does the Cookson Controls 20433-3-1 adjust through?
faq.a: The adjustment range runs from 60 to 82 degrees Celsius, set on the dial once the thermostat is fitted and the access panel is off. A manual reset over-temperature cut-out sits above the adjustment range and trips independently if stored water temperature climbs beyond safe limits.

faq.q: Can I install the 20433-3-1 myself, or do I need a licensed electrician?
faq.a: Connecting a hot water thermostat to the element circuit is electrical work and must be carried out by a licensed electrician. The thermostat mounts against the tank surface behind the access panel and lands on screw terminals, so the changeover itself is short once the circuit is isolated and tested dead.

faq.q: Which hot water systems does this universal thermostat suit?
faq.a: Single element electric storage hot water systems from a wide range of Australian manufacturers, including electric boosted solar storage tanks. It is a Robertshaw and Klixon pattern replacement and supersedes numbers including 20433-3S, 6060607, W1M280 and DY399-33, which covers many older tanks still in service.

faq.q: What does the manual reset over-temperature cut-out do?
faq.a: The cut-out breaks the element circuit if stored water temperature rises past the safe limit, typically after a thermostat or element fault. It will not restore power on its own. Someone has to press the reset by hand, which forces the underlying fault to be found rather than left running.

faq.q: How do I know the hot water thermostat has failed?
faq.a: Two symptoms point at the thermostat: no hot water at all, or water running far hotter than the dial setting. A tripped over-temperature cut-out usually means the tank has overheated. Confirm the diagnosis with a licensed electrician before replacing parts, since a failed element produces similar symptoms.

faq.q: What warranty applies to the Cookson Controls 20433-3-1?
faq.a: One year domestic use and one year commercial use, starting from the invoice date. The warranty method is return to Sparky Direct for assessment. The warranty is void if the product was not installed by a licensed electrician, so keep the installer details with the invoice.

faq.q: Will the 20433-3-1 work on a twin element tank or a heat pump system?
faq.a: No. The 20433-3-1 controls a single element and is not intended for twin element tanks that run a separate thermostat on each element. It is also not a gas or heat pump control, and it will not fit tanks that require a probe or capillary thermostat mounted in an immersion pocket.

faq.a: The Cookson Controls 20433-3-1 is available online from Sparky Direct, with Australia-wide delivery to any state or territory including regional areas. title: Daikin XF25WVMA
subtitle: LITE 2.5kW Inverter Split System Air Conditioner
descriptionHtml:
The Daikin XF25WVMA is a 2.5kW inverter split-system air conditioner rated 240V single-phase, R32 refrigerant, designed for small-to-medium residential and light commercial spaces. The XF25WVMA offers both cooling (2.5kW rated) and heating (3.0kW rated) with a compact indoor and outdoor unit footprint, five-speed fan control, and professional 5-year parts-and-labour warranty for licensed installations.

Customers fitting split-system air conditioning in rental properties, renovations, and small open-plan spaces frequently choose the Daikin XF25WVMA for affordable climate control. The compact indoor and outdoor units fit confined wall spaces where larger systems are impractical. R32 refrigerant reduces global warming potential by 66% versus older R410A, supporting regulatory trends toward lower-emission cooling. Electricians and facilities teams report strong repeat purchases driven by competitive pricing and fast delivery.

The Daikin XF25WVMA solves the problem of undersized or absent cooling in existing homes and new builds where larger units would dominate the interior. The Coanda airflow design directs cool air upward along the ceiling, distributing temperature evenly without drafting occupants, and quiet mode reduces operational noise to 19dBA, allowing the unit to run day and night without disturbance. Installation by a licensed air-conditioning technician is straightforward, with 20-metre maximum refrigerant line run and standard 6.4mm liquid and 9.5mm gas pipe connections.

Features

  • R32 Refrigerant — 66% lower global warming potential than R410A, supporting environmental compliance and future legislative restrictions on higher-GWP gases.
  • 2.5kW Cooling, 3.0kW Heating — rated under AS/NZS 3823.1.1 test conditions (27°CDB/19°CWB cooling, 20°CDB/15°CWB heating), suitable for 20–40 m² open-plan or subdivided spaces.
  • Compact Indoor/Outdoor Units — indoor dimensions 285×770×223 mm, outdoor 550×675×284 mm, designed for wall-mounted installation with minimal visual impact and flexible placement in constrained locations.
  • Coanda Airflow — discharge louvers direct air upward along the ceiling for rapid distribution and even temperature without cold-air pooling at floor level.
  • Whisper-Quiet Operation — indoor unit quiet mode reduces noise to 19dBA in cooling, 20dBA in heating, rated significantly lower than standard units operating at full speed (40dBA).
  • Five-Speed Fan Control — automatic and manual fan adjustment via wireless remote, with 24-hour and weekly timers for energy-saving scheduling and temperature set in 0.5°C increments.
  • 4.5-Star Energy Rating (Cooling) — ZERL residential cooling star rating (average climate) reflects low power input (0.53kW cool, 0.63kW heat) and EER/COP of 4.72/4.76, lowering running costs in temperate climates.
  • Compact Cross-Flow Fan and Redesigned Heat Exchanger — new motor design and slit-type fin geometry with Ø5mm piping increase thermal transfer surface and airflow efficiency, improving capacity output under load.
  • Standard 20-Metre Line Run, 15-Metre Height Difference — accommodates typical domestic and small commercial installations from outdoor unit at ground level or basement to indoor unit up to 15 metres higher.
  • 5-Year Manufacturer Warranty — Daikin parts and labour warranty for domestic professionally installed split systems covers compressor, heat exchanger, and all internal components (excludes damage, modification, or non-licensed installation).
  • Not Suitable for High-Ambient Cooling — outdoor operating range cooling is -10 to 46°C; in sustained ambient temperatures above 46°C, unit capacity reduces and cannot maintain rated output.

Where to use

  • Residential Open-Plan and Renovations — the 2.5kW capacity suits newly renovated living spaces, open-plan kitchens, and master bedrooms where ductwork is impractical and wall space is limited.
  • Small Rental Suites and Studio Apartments — compact size and affordable pricing make the XF25WVMA a cost-effective retrofit for furnished rental apartments where tenant comfort justifies individual climate control.
  • Home Offices and Studies — 2.5–3.0kW capacity maintains comfort in single-occupant work-from-home spaces, home gyms, and small dedicated work rooms without energy waste.
  • Granny Flats and Secondary Living Areas — adds cooling and heating to self-contained secondary dwellings, in-law suites, and garden studios where ducted systems are absent.
  • Small Commercial Spaces and Showrooms — light commercial applications including small retail, beauty studios, personal training rooms, and office pods benefit from low operating noise and flexible scheduling.
  • Residential and Commercial New Builds — specified as the base capacity option in new homes and small commercial projects where construction budgets require efficient, compact units.

The Daikin XF25WVMA is not rated for external walls, damp exposed locations, or outdoor weatherproof installation. The indoor unit is designed for interior walls only and should not be installed in bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchens with splash zones, or areas subject to rain exposure. For external cooling applications, weatherproof enclosures and outdoor-rated alternatives are required.

faq.q: Is the Daikin XF25WVMA suitable for my living room, and how much space can it cool?
faq.a: The XF25WVMA is rated 2.5kW cooling capacity and suits spaces of 20–40 m² in temperate climates. Cooling output is rated under standard test conditions (outdoor 35°CDB/24°CWB); in hotter climates or larger open-plan areas, cooling capacity reduces and may not maintain target temperature. Consult a licensed air-conditioning installer to confirm suitability for your specific space, orientation, insulation level, and local climate.

faq.q: What is the noise level of the XF25WVMA in normal and quiet mode?
faq.a: In quiet mode, the XF25WVMA operates at 19dBA cooling and 20dBA heating — comparable to a whisper or light library environment. At full fan speed, noise rises to 40dBA (equivalent to a normal conversation). This makes the XF25WVMA suitable for bedrooms and living areas where low background noise is valued.

faq.q: Does the XF25WVMA use R32 refrigerant, and is it compliant with regulations?
faq.a: Yes, the XF25WVMA uses R32 refrigerant, which has 66% lower global warming potential than the older R410A. R32 is approved for use in Australia under current regulations and aligns with industry trends toward lower-emission cooling solutions. Installation by a licensed technician is mandatory to ensure safe handling of refrigerant.

faq.q: What installation and pipe specifications does the XF25WVMA require?
faq.a: The XF25WVMA requires a maximum refrigerant line run of 20 metres and maximum height difference of 15 metres between outdoor and indoor units. Liquid pipe diameter is 6.4mm; gas pipe diameter is 9.5mm. Standard wall mounting requires a location within 20 metres of the outdoor unit with clear line-of-sight refrigerant piping and adequate space for condensate drain. Professional installation by a licensed air-conditioning technician is essential for compliance with Australian Standards.

faq.q: What is the warranty coverage for the Daikin XF25WVMA?
faq.a: Daikin offers a 5-year parts-and-labour domestic warranty for the XF25WVMA when professionally installed in residential premises. Warranty covers compressor, heat exchanger, electrical components, and internal mechanisms. Warranty is voided if the unit is installed by non-licensed personnel or modified. Sparky Direct provides a separate 100-day money-back guarantee on the product itself, allowing returns of unused units within 100 days of purchase.

faq.q: Can the XF25WVMA be used in kitchens, bathrooms, or outdoor areas?
faq.a: No. The XF25WVMA indoor unit is designed for interior walls only, not for damp, splashy, or outdoor environments. It should not be installed in kitchens with splash zones, bathrooms, laundries, or areas exposed to rain or high humidity. For external cooling or wet-area installations, weatherproof outdoor-rated alternatives and protective enclosures are required. Consult your air-conditioning installer if your application involves moisture or temperature extremes.

faq.q: Does the XF25WVMA support scheduling and timer functions?
faq.a: Yes. The XF25WVMA includes a 24-hour daily timer and weekly scheduler accessible via wireless remote. You can set automatic turn-on and turn-off times for each day of the week, allowing customized operation around occupancy and energy-saving schedules. Temperature adjustment is available in 0.5°C increments.

faq.q: Where can I buy the Daikin XF25WVMA near me?
faq.a: You can purchase the Daikin XF25WVMA online from Sparky Direct. Delivery is available to select postcodes — just check the product page to see if yours is covered. If your area isn't covered for delivery, click-and-collect from Caboolture, Queensland is available.

title: Victron Energy BPC121542012
subtitle: 230V Blue Smart IP22 Charger 12V/15Amp
descriptionHtml:
Victron Blue Smart Bluetooth 12-volt 15-amp single output battery charger with IP22 rating suitable for AGM, Gel and Lithium Ion battery charging (AU/NZ model).

Features:

The battery is charged, smartly… to perfect condition

The seven-step charging algorithm gets the best out of your battery. The charger gives the battery the power it needs, maintains its health, and ensures better performance… and longer life.

Recovery of deeply-discharged ‘dead’ batteries

Unlike other brands, the Blue Smart IP22 Charger will attempt to recharge a deeply-discharged battery by force-feeding it with a low current. Normal charging will then be resumed as soon as there is sufficient voltage across the battery terminals.

Check the status of your battery remotely

The Blue Smart IP22 is equipped with built-in Bluetooth, so the status of the charger and the battery can be checked on a smartphone, tablet or laptop. All settings of the charger can be configured with the VictronConnect app.

Bluetooth Smart

The Blue Smart IP22 Charger is the wireless solution to monitor voltage and current, to change settings and to update the charger when new features become available.

High efficiency

With up to 94% efficiency, these chargers generate up to four times less heat when compared to the industry standard.
And once the battery is fully charged, power consumption reduces to 0,5 Watt, some five to ten times better than the industry standard.

Adaptive 6-stage charge algorithm: test – bulk – absorption – recondition – float – storage

The Blue Smart Charger features a microprocessor-controlled ‘adaptive’ battery management. The adaptive feature will automatically optimize the charging process relative to the way the battery is being used.

Storage Mode: less maintenance and aging when the battery is not in use

The storage mode kicks in whenever the battery has not been subjected to discharge during 24 hours. In the storage mode, float voltage is reduced to 2,2V/cell (13,2V for a 12V battery) to minimize gassing and corrosion of the positive plates. Once a week the voltage is raised back to the absorption level to ‘equalize’ the battery. This feature prevents stratification of the electrolyte and sulfation, a major cause of early battery failure.

Also charges Li-ion (LiFePO₄) batteries

LiFePO₄ batteries are charged with a simple bulk – absorption – float algorithm.

NIGHT and LOW setting

When in NIGHT or LOW mode, the output current is reduced to max. 50% of the nominal output and the charger will be totally noiseless. The NIGHT mode automatically ends after 8 hours. The LOW mode can be ended manually.

Protected against overheating

Output current will reduce as temperature increases up to 50°C, but the Blue Smart Charger will not fail.

title: Clipsal MX9R3210S

descriptionHtml:
The Max9 Clipsal MX9R3210S product is a residual current breaker with overcurrent protection (RCBO).
The MX9R3210S is a 1P+N circuit breaker with 1 protected pole, 10A In rated current at 30øC and C tripping curve.

MCB/RCD Combinations – 2 module Type A-SI RCBO

Clipsal switchboard mounted combination MCBs and RCDs fall into two main categories - electro-mechanical and electronic.

The electro-mechanical devices derive their ‘action energy’ from actual leakage (residual) current.
They work on an electromagnetic principle. A toroidal transformer is used to detect the magnetic fields created by current flowing in the Active and Neutral wires of the protected circuit, which pass through the RCD.
Taking into account the magnitude and direction of these currents, under normal circuit conditions the vector sum of the currents (known as the residual current) is effectively zero and the magnetic fields cancel.
Should the condition occur where a current flows from an Active or Neutral wire to Earth, the residual current will not be zero and the magnetic field will establish a tripping signal to disconnect the protected circuit. These devices are not voltage dependant. 

Features and benefits:

  • Separate RCD trip flag for easy trip diagnosis
  • The same base module as the MCBs. Uniformity in space requirements and installation.
  • Top and bottom line and load compatible for ease of installation
  • Green strip on the toggle that indicates the opening of all the poles
  • Top and bottom clip allowing dismounting with comb busbar in place
  • Busbar compatible through an insulated slot

Applications

  • Super Immune - A-SI Type
  • High dependency installation.

Specifications:

  • The operating frequency is 50Hz.
  • The earth leakage protection class is type A-SI (Super Immunised) with a sensitivity of 30mA.
  • The earth-leakage protection time delay is instantaneous.
  • The Icn rated short circuit breaking capacity is up to 6000A at 240VAC.
  • It has an electrical endurance going up to 10000 cycles and mechanical endurance going up to 20000 cycles.
  • This product protects against short circuits, cable overload, electrical shock by indirect contact and fire hazards.
  • It brings safe, reliable solutions for commercial and industrial applications with high breaking capacity.

descriptionHtml:

The 20405 delivers 1800–1900 lumens with a 120-degree beam angle and is fully dimmable with leading-edge or trailing-edge dimmer switches. It complies with MEPS AS/NZS 4847.2-2010 and is rated IP44 for indoor and protected outdoor installations. The 20405 comes complete with driver, flex, and plug.

Upgrading from older halogen or incandescent downlights is a common retrofit in domestic and commercial settings. Most existing downlights operate on 50mm to 100mm hole spacings, but modern LED fixtures often require larger cut-outs for cooling and driver placement. The 20405 solves this with a 150mm cut-out that covers 170mm-plus gaps left by older fittings. Licensed electricians value the large footprint because it eliminates the need for trim rings or repair work on ceilings, and the tri-colour tuning simplifies site-specific matches when retrofitting houses with mixed colour-temperature fittings. The 120-degree beam angle floods ceiling voids evenly, a practical advantage over narrow-beam alternatives when upgrading whole rooms or open-plan layouts.

The NLS 20405 fits electrical contractors' workflows because the downlight ships with flex and plug included, so it wires straight into a surface socket without rewiring. The dimmable design works with both leading-edge and trailing-edge dimmers, which matters on renovation jobs where the site's existing switch technology is unknown. Brightness and colour tuning give contractors a quick upsell on standard quotes (most homeowners ask "can we make them brighter?" or "can we match the kitchen warmth?"), and the tri-colour feature commands retail margins that single-colour units do not. Stock rotation is straightforward because all NLS 20405 units use the same ballast and optics—bulk orders simplify inventory tracking.

Features

  • 20-watt power consumption — delivers 1800–1900 lumens with 90% energy saving versus traditional incandescent downlights, rated to AS/NZS 4847.2-2010 MEPS standard.
  • Tri-colour LED tuning — switch between 3000K warm white, 4000K neutral, and 6000K daylight to match existing fittings or customise room ambience without swapping globes.
  • Dimmable with standard dimmers — works with both leading-edge and trailing-edge dimmer switches, so no special circuit upgrades are needed on retrofit jobs.
  • 120-degree beam angle — wide flood pattern lights entire ceiling cavities and large rooms evenly, reduces dark corners common with narrow-beam downlights.
  • 150mm cut-out diameter — covers gaps from 150mm up to 170mm left by old fittings, eliminating trim-ring and ceiling-repair costs on retrofit work.
  • IP44 rating — rated for indoor use and protected outdoor installations; not suitable for unshielded or fully exposed wet locations.
  • Includes driver, flex, and plug — the complete downlight assembly plugs directly into a standard surface socket; no rewiring or ballast installation required.
  • 50,000-hour lifespan — rated for approximately 50,000 hours of continuous operation, translating to 10+ years at typical domestic usage rates.
  • 240V 50Hz mains operation — standard Australian power rating; input current 0.1A and power factor 0.95 for efficient integration into domestic and commercial circuits.
  • White finish — semi-recessed trim ring finish blends with ceiling voids; does not project below plasterboard plane when flush-installed.

Where to use

  • Lounge and entertainment areas — the NLS 20405 floods living rooms and open-plan spaces with brightness, colour-tuning lets homeowners dial in warm or cool light depending on time of day and mood.
  • Kitchens and dining — triple-colour tuning simplifies matching existing pendant or wall-mounted fittings; dimmable design supports ambient and task lighting on a single circuit.
  • Bedroom ceiling retrofits — replace old incandescent downlights with the 20405 for silent, flicker-free operation and colour warmth control, especially useful in master bedrooms and guest rooms.
  • Bathroom ceiling lighting — IP44 rating and recessed profile suit bathroom ceilings; moisture-sealed driver sits safely within the ceiling void.
  • Workshop and garage upgrades — high lumen output (1800–1900lm) and wide beam angle brighten workbenches and storage areas; full brightness is instant (no warm-up time unlike halogen).
  • Commercial office retrofits — fits standard suspended-ceiling grids; dimmer compatibility supports meeting rooms and flexible office layouts.
  • Renovation and new-build specifications — the plug-and-play design speeds up interior-fit work; colour tuning appeals to property finishers and developers targeting high-value rental or sale listings.

The NLS 20405 is not suitable for fully exposed outdoor or wet-weather installations, submerged or splash-immersion use, or non-dimmable circuits where a dimmable driver would create compatibility issues. The 150mm cut-out is mandatory and cannot be reduced; do not attempt to install into smaller ceiling voids.

"Lights are very bright and light up my large loungeroom with ease." — Brett H

"They do dim which many LEDs claim to do but can't." — The GC

faq.q: What colour temperature options does the NLS 20405 offer?
faq.a: The 20405 is tri-colour tunable with three selectable temperature options: 3000K warm white for relaxed ambience, 4000K neutral for general task lighting, and 6000K daylight for kitchens and work areas. You can switch between colours without changing globes.

faq.q: Can I install this downlight myself, or do I need a licensed electrician?
faq.a: Installation must be carried out by a licensed electrician. The 20405 requires a 150mm ceiling cut-out, routing of the driver into the ceiling void, and safe connection to the home's electrical circuit. In Queensland and most of Australia, downlight installation is a notifiable electrical job.

faq.q: Does this downlight work with my existing dimmer switch?
faq.a: Yes, the 20405 is fully dimmable and compatible with both leading-edge and trailing-edge dimmer switches. No special dimmer or circuit modifications are needed. Check that your dimmer is rated for LED loads (most modern dimmers are) for flicker-free performance.

faq.q: What is the difference between the NLS 20405 and the older single-colour downlights?
faq.a: The 20405 delivers 1800–1900 lumens from 20 watts, compared to older 13–15 watt single-colour units delivering 900–1350 lumens. The tri-colour tuning gives you flexibility to match different colour temperatures around your house without swapping units. The 150mm cut-out also covers larger ceiling voids left by older fittings, eliminating trim-ring costs.

faq.q: How long will this downlight last?

faq.q: What is the warranty on this downlight?

Warranty is void if the downlight is modified, used outside its rated electrical parameters, or installed by an unlicensed person. In-home servicing is available through Sparky Direct's warranty team; contact them within 48 hours of fault detection.

faq.q: Will this downlight work in bathrooms and wet areas?
faq.a: The 20405 is IP44 rated, meaning it is suitable for indoor installations and protected outdoor locations (eaves, covered patios). Bathroom ceiling use (above the ceiling plane, inside the void) is safe; do not use over shower enclosures or in direct-spray environments.

title: Schneider Electric TeSys LC1D25N7
subtitle: D Contactor 25A · AC-3 · 415Vac Coil
descriptionHtml:
The TeSys D contactor is a device used for controlling motors. It has three poles. It is normally open (NO), meaning the circuits are not connected when the contactor is not energised. It is designed for motor control applications with a maximum current rating of 25A and a voltage rating of 690V in AC-3 mode (suitable for motor power of 11kW at 400V).

The contactor has a coil that operates on 415V AC power at 50/60Hz. It also has built-in auxiliary contacts, consisting of one normally open (NO) and one normally closed (NC) contact. These auxiliary contacts are certified to provide reliable switching.

The connection to the contactor is made using screw clamp terminals, which provide secure and easy-to-use connections. The contactor is designed to handle high operating rates of up to 3600 cycles per hour and can operate in environments with temperatures up to 60 degrees Celsius. This ensures its reliability and durability in demanding applications.

The TeSys D contactor has a compact design with a width of 45mm, allowing for easy installation on a DIN rail or through screw fixing. It is certified to meet multiple international standards, including IEC, UL, CSA, CCC, EAC, and Marine.
